# Hammer Enchantment

[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/hammer-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/hammer-enchantment)

## 📖 Description

New enchantment with three levels for tools to mine multiple blocks like a hammer!

The enchantment can be obtained from the enchantment table, loot chests or trading with villagers.

Compatible with [Smelting](https://modrinth.com/datapack/smelting-enchantment) and [Magnetic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/magnetic-enchantment) Enchantments!

---

## ⚠️ Incompatibilities

Not compatible with:
- [Configurable Despawn Timer](https://modrinth.com/mod/configurable-despawn-timer)
- [Quad](https://modrinth.com/mod/quad)

---

## ⌨️ Commands

Give:

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot hammer_enchantment:hammer/<level>
```

Enchant:

```mcfunction
/enchant @s hammer_enchantment:hammer
```
